Playable preview of Urban Sprawl. Pick a town style and seed, place the town hall at an old crossroads, and watch the town build itself. One lever: the property tax.

**Downloads**
- Windows: `urban-sprawl-*-windows-x64.zip`, unzip and run `urban-sprawl.exe`.
- macOS (Apple silicon): `urban-sprawl-*-macos-arm64.zip`, unzip and move `Urban Sprawl.app` anywhere. It is ad-hoc signed, not notarised, so the first launch needs **right click, Open**, then Open again. If macOS says the app is damaged, run `xattr -cr "Urban Sprawl.app"` in Terminal once and open it again.
- Linux: `urban-sprawl-*-linux-x64.tar.gz`, extract and run `./urban-sprawl`. Needs a Vulkan driver and the usual desktop libraries (libxkbcommon-x11).

Controls and notes are in the README inside each archive.
